lints.name: auth_users_exposed
lints.title: Exposed Auth Users
lints.description: Detects if auth.users is exposed to anon or authenticated roles via a view or materialized view in schemas exposed to PostgREST, potentially compromising user data security.

findings.detail: View/Materialized View "staff_directory_v" in the public schema may expose \`auth.users\` data to anon or authenticated roles.

lints.name: rls_enabled_no_policy
lints.title: RLS Enabled No Policy
lints.description: Detects cases where row level security (RLS) has been enabled on a table but no RLS policies have been created.

findings.detail: Table \`public.staff_auth_pins\` has RLS enabled, but no policies exist
Table \`record_editor_private.receipts\` has RLS enabled, but no policies exist

lints.name: anon_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Public Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable without signing in. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if it is not meant to be public.

findings.detail: Function `public.adjust_stock(p_product_id uuid, p_delta integer, p_reason text, p_actor_id uuid, p_client_uuid uuid)` can be executed by the `anon` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/adjust_stock`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
